mentions.name: Fine-grained GitHub API proxy
mentions.description: A proxy over GitHub's REST API that provides fine-grained repository access control, such as file-level scopes, designed for unpredictable agents that need scoped API access.
mentions.source_excerpt: Proxy over GitHub’s REST API for fine-grained repo access – e.g. file-level scopes. For unpredictable agents :)
